rationale: Native Linux sample derivations and meaningful regression tests are verified. Darwin runtime execution is absent from the inspected CI; this prevents Tier 2. The executed supported current line is demonstrated.

evaluation.summary: All 28 executable checks.x86_64-linux attributes evaluate and realize successfully at 6e0980414b91c7e8c379ebf5bb5292f7d66da537. Exact derivations, native outputs and NAR hashes are in the packet; native aarch64-linux CI independently succeeds.

goodTests.summary: Successful executable unit and conformance derivations cover lock parsing, missing/tampered/stale locks, workspaces, source/path/registry packages, releases, builder overrides and offline behavior. The independent Elysia derivation runs 1,616 upstream tests (1,614 pass, two skips). Later producer cold pure sandbox and empty-cache negative-control evidence is outside this reviewed baseline.

linux.summary: Native aarch64-linux CI builds the required sample/check derivations successfully at the exact reviewed revision; local x86_64-linux checks also realize successfully. Neither result is cross-evaluation.

darwin.summary: The inspected .github/workflows/check.yml and successful native jobs cover ubuntu-latest and ubuntu-24.04-arm only. The flake declares aarch64-darwin, which is not execution. No successful native Darwin sample derivation/SDK/output receipt is available; this Linux review host cannot execute it.

oneVersion.summary: Actual native sample execution demonstrates Bun 1.4.2. Scope is the exact executed version point(s), not a version range.

nonEolVersions.summary: Bun SECURITY.md explicitly supports the 1.x.x family. Native Elysia and fixture derivations execute Bun 1.4.2, a point in that current supported family. Upstream latest is 1.4.4; this judgment claims the executed family point, not unexecuted patches, binary identities or all 1.x releases.

manySamples.summary: Elysia is one independent upstream application; workspace, registry, path and source cases are owned fixtures. Their diversity supports test quality but does not yet demonstrate many independent upstream applications.

longCompatibility.summary: Only native Bun 1.4.2 is demonstrated. Package tarballs containing other Bun version strings are dependencies, not execution of those runtimes.
